Width conflict: Wikipedia's infobox gives 1,855 mm, Kia's heritage archive 1,735 mm; the manufacturer figure is recorded. Kia gives overall lengths as a range of 3,760–4,350 mm, which differs from Wikipedia's per-body lengths.
Wikipedia lists two wheelbases (2,360 mm and 2,650 mm) without saying which body each belongs to, so they are not recorded. The extended 'Grand' version used the same wheelbase as the standard wagon.
The four-wheel-drive system's type (part-time with low range or not) is not stated in the sources, so it is recorded generically as AWD.

Wikipedia's engine table also lists a 2.2 diesel (2,184 cc) with figures given only as 'HP'; Kia's heritage page confirms displacements of 1,998–2,184 cc. It is not recorded as a powertrain because its output and market are not reliably sourced.
Wikipedia mentions facelifts (1998–2001 and 2002–2005 photo captions) but gives no dates or changes; no revision is recorded.
Wikipedia states the 1997 model year Sportage was the first production vehicle with a knee airbag.
The generation code: Wikipedia gives NB. No manufacturer source for the code was found.
